about: The RDSO standard drawing sets the sheet is built from (tools/build_rdso_sheet.py reads this list). A set is one row: its id, its series, and its parts — each an extract folder (read by eye from the PDF, one JSON per page) with the PDF it was read from and the extraction's own verification: the pages checked, the columns spot-checked per page, the pages not to use, and whether the part was checked at all. Adding a set is adding a row here and running the builder; nothing in a row is a value of a standard.
